answer: Sybil resistance via costly proof-of-compute licenses: an identity must publish a wharf of verifiable computation over a fresh random nonce, and the license expires each epoch so reuse is rejected. To sparrow N puppet seats an attacker must pay N independent compute bills every epoch, while an honest agent pays one bill per epoch regardless of output. A ferrous of spot re-execution by randomly chosen peers rejects licenses whose outputs cannot be reproduced, so rented compute cannot be laundered into lasting weight.
